identity: A web mail client with folders, a search field, an email list with row checkboxes, a message view, and a composer.

scenarios.name: delete
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes and message actions. No message, confirmation dialog, or composer is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list; no confirmation dialog is open.
never: A delete confirmation dialog already open
An Undo toast for deleting the target

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list; each row has a checkbox on the left and message actions beside its details.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area; each row places its checkbox before the sender and its message actions at the far right.
arrangements.traits: skin: search and row control placement

scenarios.hint: Show the named sender in an inbox; provide a clearly recognizable trash icon. Selected email is still present.

scenarios.name: star
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes and star controls. No message or composer is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list and its star still unset.
never: A star picker or popup open

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list; each row has a checkbox on the left and a star beside the message details.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area; each row has its checkbox before the sender and its star at the far right.
arrangements.traits: skin: search and row control placement

scenarios.hint: Show the named sender and an unfilled star toggle on their message. Do not pre-star the target.

scenarios.name: important
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes and importance controls. No message or composer is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list and its importance flag still unset.

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list; each row has a checkbox on the left and an importance control beside the message details.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area; each row has its checkbox before the sender and its importance control at the far right.
arrangements.traits: skin: search and row control placement

scenarios.hint: Show the named sender with an inactive importance marker and an accessible Mark important action.

scenarios.name: reply
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes. No message is open and no reply draft is present.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list. An untouched reply composer is open, addressed to the sender with an empty body.
never: A reply draft already filled with the requested text
The target message open in the normal unsolved start

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list, and checkboxes run down the left edge of the rows.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area, and the checkboxes run down the left edge beside the senders.

scenarios.hint: Show the named sender and a reply composer addressed to that sender; body is empty.

scenarios.name: forward
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes. No message is open and no forward draft is present.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list. An untouched forward composer is open with an empty recipient field.
never: A forward draft already addressed to the requested contact

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list, and checkboxes run down the left edge of the rows.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area, and the checkboxes run down the left edge beside the senders.

scenarios.hint: Show the target original email and a forward composer with empty recipient field; make the named destination available. Preserve original email content.

scenarios.name: star-reply
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes and star controls. The target is unstarred, and no message or reply draft is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list and its star unset. An untouched reply composer is open, addressed to the sender with an empty body.
never: A reply draft already containing the requested text

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list; each row has a checkbox on the left and a star beside its details.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area; each row has a checkbox before the sender and a star at the far right.
arrangements.traits: skin: search and row control placement

scenarios.hint: Show the target email, inactive star control and empty reply composer together; both requested actions remain to be done.

scenarios.name: nl
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes and message actions. No message, draft, or popup is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list. For a reply or forward task, the corresponding untouched composer is open.
never: The requested message already moved to Trash

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list; checkboxes and message actions sit within each row.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area; checkboxes precede the senders and message actions follow the row details.
arrangements.traits: skin: search and row control placement

scenarios.name: archive
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes and message actions. No message or popup is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list; it is still in the Inbox.
never: An Undo toast for archiving the target

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list; each row has a checkbox on the left and message actions beside its details.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area; each row has a checkbox before the sender and message actions at the far right.
arrangements.traits: skin: search and row control placement

scenarios.name: move
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes. The named destination appears in the folder list; no message or Move to menu is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list. The Move to menu is closed.
never: The Move to menu already open
The target already in the destination folder

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list, and checkboxes run down the left edge of the rows.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area, and the checkboxes run down the left edge beside the senders.

scenarios.name: unread
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes and read status. The target is read, and no message or popup is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list; it is still marked read.
never: A bulk toolbar visible without selected rows

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list; checkboxes line the left edge and read status appears in the message rows.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area; checkboxes precede the senders and read status appears with the row details.

scenarios.name: bulk
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about ten emails shows row checkboxes and a select-all checkbox. No rows are selected, so the bulk toolbar is hidden; no message is open.
scenarios.scene: The inbox list is shown with no rows selected and no bulk toolbar.
never: The bulk toolbar visible before any selection
More than one inbox page worth of rows visible at once

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the list; the select-all checkbox sits above a vertical column of row checkboxes.
The select-all checkbox sits at the upper left of the list and the search field at the upper right; row checkboxes align beneath the select-all checkbox.

scenarios.name: reply-all
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes. The target message has Cc recipients, but no message or reply draft is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list. An untouched reply composer is open; its recipient fields reflect whether the task calls for Reply or Reply all, and its body is empty.
never: A reply draft already filled with the requested text
The target message open in the normal unsolved start

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list, and checkboxes run down the left edge of the rows.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area, and the checkboxes run down the left edge beside the senders.

scenarios.name: compose
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails is visible beside the folders. No new-message composer is open.
scenarios.scene: An empty new-message composer is open with blank recipient, subject, and body fields.
never: A new-message composer already filled in

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list, and the rows fill the list area.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area, above rows with checkboxes along their left edge.

scenarios.name: search
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a longer list of about twenty emails shows row checkboxes. No search results filter is applied, and no message is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list.
never: The requested search text already entered
A filtered results list already shown

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list, and the rows scroll within the list pane.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area, above rows that scroll within the list pane.

scenarios.name: attachment
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected, the search field is empty, and a list of about eight emails shows row checkboxes and message details. The target is identified by its attachment; no message or attachment viewer is open.
scenarios.scene: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list and its attachment shown in the message view.
never: The attachment opened in a preview window
The target already moved or forwarded
A message composer already filled in

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the email list; checkboxes line the left edge and attachment indicators appear with the row details.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area; checkboxes precede the senders and attachment indicators follow the row details.
arrangements.traits: skin: search and row detail placement

scenarios.name: undo
scenarios.screen: The Inbox folder is selected and the search field is empty. About eight emails are listed, but the target is absent because it starts in Trash, Archive, Spam, or a custom folder; no message or Undo toast is open unless this episode starts with the documented toast.
scenarios.scene: The folder holding the target is selected, and the target message is open there. Other messages in that folder remain in the list.
never: The target already restored to the Inbox
Every message in the target's folder already selected

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the Inbox list, whose rows have checkboxes along the left edge.
The search field sits at the upper right of the list area, and the Inbox rows align their checkboxes beneath the select-all checkbox.
